name: kb_431_Normalized

schema.description: IDRange provides a min/max of an allowed range of IDs. Deprecated: use IDRange from policy API Group instead.

max.description: max is the end of the range, inclusive.

min.description: min is the start of the range, inclusive.

description:
Please note that the permitted identifier block for this service begins at 1000 and runs through 2000, both limits being inclusive. Any IDs assigned outside of this span will be rejected by the validation routine.

Be aware that this particular ID‑range definition is now deprecated; future deployments should reference the IDRange type provided by the policy API group instead.
